Row.Text: When ON, every civilization's capital gains a set of wonder-style bonuses: +30% Worker build speed, +150 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness, and +10% [ICON_FOOD] Food (faster growth) in all of its cities. Turn OFF for a standard Vox Populi Palace with none of these bonuses.

When ON, an enemy civilian Great Person (Writer, Artist, Musician, Scientist, Merchant, Engineer or Diplomat) is captured instead of destroyed when you take the tile it stands on - just like capturing a Worker. When OFF, Great People are destroyed, as in standard Vox Populi. (Great Generals and Great Admirals are never capturable.)
When ON, the late-game futuristic Mech and XCOM Squad units cannot be built or trained by any civilization, keeping the modern era grounded. Turn OFF to allow them to be built normally.
